summary: The registry auth secret can be created from existing Podman credentials at `${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR}/containers/auth.json`; create it in the RHDH project before configuring plug-ins, use a registry service account token, and verify with `oc get secret`.
questions: Can I reuse my Podman login for the RHDH plug-in secret?
Should I use my personal Red Hat credentials for the registry secret?
How do I verify the dynamic plugins registry secret exists?
